The figure shows two line graphs. 

The two graphs show the impact of knowledge distillation weight and masking probability on speech translation performance. 

The x-axis of the left graph is labeled "α" with values ranging from 0.1 to 0.9, marked at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is unlabeled but has values from 28.0 to 28.5, marked at intervals of 0.1. The graph has a single blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately (0.1, 28.0), peaking at (0.5, 28.5), and ending at (0.9, 28.2).

The x-axis of the right graph is labeled "p" with values ranging from 0.05 to 0.45, marked at intervals of 0.05 or 0.1. The y-axis is unlabeled but has values from 28.0 to 28.5, marked at intervals of 0.1. The graph has a single blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately (0.05, 28.2), ending at (0.45, 28.45), and with a peak at (0.15, 28.5).
